Nikolai V: Heads-up — Helios (partner) wants ap-central-3 onboarding. They propose a split between marketplace SKUs and private edge nodes via StratusSI. Primary asks: marketplace entitlements for 18 A100-80GB, fallback to A10 for burst, HSM-backed KMS, and coordinated announcement with SI. Ops/legal please advise.
Sara (Helios): Correct. We'll commit 18 A100-80 (hl-a100-80-prod) and allow hl-a10-40-burst for best-effort. StratusSI will manage private edge installs and needs an entitlement mapping so traffic can be routed to edge when latency-sensitive.
Tom B: Ops: need exact SKUs & region code, go-live target, and expected QPS. Also confirm whether StratusSI edge nodes will use same KMS or customer-managed HSMs.
Sara (Helios): Go-live target 2026-12-10. SKUs: hl-a100-80-prod, hl-a10-40-burst. StratusSI will use customer-managed HSMs (KMIP) at edge; for marketplace traffic we require CloudHSM in-region. Rotation 90 days.
Jin L: Legal: we need an addendum covering hybrid routing (marketplace -> edge), key custody, and SI responsibilities. Can Helios sign a quick MSA addendum pre-go-live?
Anika (StratusSI): Quick clarify — our edge nodes will be deployed on customer premises and we need a mapping file to accept traffic via partner routing. Also need a small-scale validation window to test failover.
MarketplaceBot: marketplace-submission: submission_id=msub-20261005-221; status=review_pending; reviewer=marketplace-team@helios.com
Nikolai V: Draft entitlement payload I'm going to submit:
```json
{
  "partner": "Helios",
  "region": "ap-central-3",
  "skus": ["hl-a100-80-prod","hl-a10-40-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity": 18,
  "edge_integration": "StratusSI-hybrid-routing",
  "go_live_date": "2026-12-10"
}
```
Tom B: Ops runbook items — propose partner canary 2026-11-29 02:00-06:00 UTC, internal canary 2026-12-03 08:00-12:00 UTC. Success: p95 < 220ms, sustained 1.0M tokens/hr, edge failover < 15% traffic deviation.
Jin L: I'll draft the addendum and post in drive. Need Helios legal contact for signature.
Sara (Helios): Helios legal contact: legal@helios.com. We'll review addendum ASAP. Also proposing a two-week embargo; tentative public announce 2026-12-24.
Anika (StratusSI): We'll prepare edge routing mapping template and a minimal validation checklist. Will upload by EOD Fri.
MarketplaceBot: status_update: submission_id=msub-20261005-221; status=approved 2026-10-07T09:12Z
OpsBot: scheduled-canary: 2026-11-29T02:00Z-2026-11-29T06:00Z; notify=#eng-runtime #eng-sre
Nikolai V: Assignments: Jin legal addendum, Anika edge mapping + validation, Tom ops runbook + canaries, Sara partner coord + marketplace follow-up. If blockers surface, ping me.
Sara (Helios): Thanks all — will send calendar invites and Helios marketing blurb by Monday. :rocket:
